newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MICEX bourse to trade Russian shares from March 25.
newsitem.headline: MICEX bourse to trade Russian shares from March 25.

text.p: The Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX) will start trading shares in three leading Russian companies on March 25, the chief executive of the exchange said on Wednesday.
Alexander Zakharov told a news conference that trade would be offered in Moscow power utility Mosenergo, long distance carrier Rostelekom and metals company Norilsk Nickel.
Leading oil producer LUKoil is in the process of registering for listing, MICEX officials said.
MICEX is the official floor for the large and transparent government securities market. UNEXIM bank will act as share depositary.
The vast majority of Russian shares are traded through the Russian Trading System, a NASDAQ-like dealer-to-dealer, over-the-counter system.
